agent_explanation: At step 28, controlled body 0 is almost touching fast body 1 (gap 0.005). The collision between 28-29 imparts large impulse, reversing velocity from ~2.9 m/s toward waypoint to ~10.3 m/s away. Controller's velocity-error law (kp * error) then commands force 486.8 N, far above fmax 72.67. Simulation does not clamp or re-check controller force after collision substeps, so the violation persists at final step. Removing the colliding body eliminates the velocity spike and violation.
